releaseNotes:
## What's Changed

### 架构重构

* 抽出不依赖 Tauri 的 micyou-core，GUI、CLI 与 TUI 共用同一套服务端核心 by @ChouChiu in https://github.com/MicYou-Dev/MicYou/pull/352
* 桌面窗口改为自绘无边框外壳 by @ChouChiu in https://github.com/MicYou-Dev/MicYou/pull/353
* 前端按 platform 层与 features 重新组织 by @ChouChiu in https://github.com/MicYou-Dev/MicYou/pull/355
* 前端包管理器切换到 bun by @ChouChiu in https://github.com/MicYou-Dev/MicYou/pull/354
* 统一服务启动流程，拆分前端产物 by @ChouChiu in https://github.com/MicYou-Dev/MicYou/commit/5c1a50824209ee3ce0a4466a7febbb1b0b27bd85
* 前端事件监听随组件作用域自动注销 by @ChouChiu in https://github.com/MicYou-Dev/MicYou/commit/ecd4fa6ef65bed378680149ce15a3c610862117b
* 分离 DSP 插件的 DSP 节点 by @OrientCOMPASS in https://github.com/MicYou-Dev/MicYou/pull/348

### 桌面端

* 新增 IPv6 支持（实验性，默认双栈自动绑定） by @OrientCOMPASS in https://github.com/MicYou-Dev/MicYou/pull/345
* 新增禁用静音同步选项 by @OrientCOMPASS in https://github.com/MicYou-Dev/MicYou/pull/344
* CLI serve 新增 --quiet 参数，屏蔽高频电平日志 by @OrientCOMPASS in https://github.com/MicYou-Dev/MicYou/pull/341
* 窗口加入进出场动画，设置窗口改为复用 by @ChouChiu in https://github.com/MicYou-Dev/MicYou/commit/7ac08364548e13413cfe2d83cbff01125dc45bdc
* 统一对话框与面板动效 by @ChouChiu in https://github.com/MicYou-Dev/MicYou/commit/390cf6f9ee1799731c90d857d9696c4a96f5651b
* Linux 默认启用 DMA-BUF 渲染器 by @ChouChiu in https://github.com/MicYou-Dev/MicYou/commit/07316aa9f6c9a486385ed73fd16061f215eec600
* 修复 Windows 上设置窗口死锁 by @ChouChiu in https://github.com/MicYou-Dev/MicYou/commit/701485ce5a4974b0ead718e874c8728e0931c273
* 修复窗口重建后 KWin 模糊与阴影丢失，失败时记录日志 by @ChouChiu in https://github.com/MicYou-Dev/MicYou/commit/e7aa73dad1945be7d264e19dbba32a5a1ac2a4b8
* 修复 Windows 端扬声器空闲时误判 AEC 参考流中断 by @OrientCOMPASS in https://github.com/MicYou-Dev/MicYou/pull/360
* 将 Homebrew 路径加入 adb 常用路径 by @chen1plus in https://github.com/MicYou-Dev/MicYou/pull/336
* USB 模式下 CLI 与 TUI 忽略已保存的网卡，修复连接被拒 by @ChouChiu in https://github.com/MicYou-Dev/MicYou/commit/3a2539945ad6c3ec243f4f83eaa0cd74b83a1612
* TUI 主循环移出异步工作线程，节流改为无锁实现 by @ChouChiu in https://github.com/MicYou-Dev/MicYou/commit/5c0b880503030723468d0f25b62463cb63b7498f

### 音频与连接

* 抖动缓冲预缓冲改为按时长计算（约 100ms），突发丢包一次跳过 by @ChouChiu in https://github.com/MicYou-Dev/MicYou/commit/96f60b60aa0a84c70c4deba5ae7d44523445897e
* 丢包率不再计入重复包 by @ChouChiu in https://github.com/MicYou-Dev/MicYou/commit/a876e8abccbb3a8ef67cd43f0386c26336a60690
* 音频线程遇到异常输入或锁中毒时保持运行，非有限采样置零 by @ChouChiu in https://github.com/MicYou-Dev/MicYou/commit/d0bf11fcf2a55faeb092778e704a6b143a2e1ca4
* 输出队列水位改为原子读取，不再往返设备线程 by @ChouChiu in https://github.com/MicYou-Dev/MicYou/commit/8f3c4c34570c5e2d31420055e5d9b544e751530c
* 修复音频线程定时器创建在运行时之外的问题 by @ChouChiu in https://github.com/MicYou-Dev/MicYou/commit/d5e0df23b9f66d5b3bd674e4b256ac1c9cd8346a
* 传输层恢复中毒的会话锁 by @ChouChiu in https://github.com/MicYou-Dev/MicYou/commit/9894d088fc176f29703f3dca4fd8257d948b9e5f
* 网页模式停止服务时关闭 WebSocket，网卡顺序变化时保留证书 by @ChouChiu in https://github.com/MicYou-Dev/MicYou/commit/544bbd729524cc556c73d7212034689bfe541f15
* 加固桌面服务端核心 by @ChouChiu in https://github.com/MicYou-Dev/MicYou/commit/ab9ade13e2fa84c672885d93d712b0d8ada9ad0e

### 插件

* 插件市场新增 README 按钮，插件文档新增 readmeUrl 字段 by @OrientCOMPASS in https://github.com/MicYou-Dev/MicYou/pull/334
* 优化并修复若干插件系统体验 by @OrientCOMPASS in https://github.com/MicYou-Dev/MicYou/pull/335
* 实现可用于生产的 audio_state 与 connected_devices API by @OrientCOMPASS in https://github.com/MicYou-Dev/MicYou/pull/340
* 插件文档补充 API 使用注意事项 by @OrientCOMPASS in https://github.com/MicYou-Dev/MicYou/pull/342
* 连续失败的 DSP 插件节点自动隔离，丢弃非有限输出 by @ChouChiu in https://github.com/MicYou-Dev/MicYou/commit/569587027e6465cf0ffbb9843b18d7ca116ccbed
* 原生插件初始化失败后跳过 deinit by @ChouChiu in https://github.com/MicYou-Dev/MicYou/commit/1e5e1b1cd2944d18862291fafee83d6fa5f9e93f
* 限制插件压缩包解压大小与条目数，校验市场插件 ID by @ChouChiu in https://github.com/MicYou-Dev/MicYou/commit/164785e8f77d8437cf0fcb3a8ab66efcbcf2ca46
* 拒绝含空标签的插件 ID by @ChouChiu in https://github.com/MicYou-Dev/MicYou/commit/dccd047fb2c753ee407a0779519f2a3850a4757e
* 简化 WASM 宿主内存访问与权限检查 by @ChouChiu in https://github.com/MicYou-Dev/MicYou/commit/9a9a5535b8724ce277fa3519bbe2606d422ceade

### Android

* 修复 Android 14+ 上划掉应用后反复提示崩溃 by @ChouChiu in https://github.com/MicYou-Dev/MicYou/commit/24a0fdca500943f8905c43ac08d7458409d8f767
* 推流中划掉应用时干净退出，停止推流并移除通知 by @ChouChiu in https://github.com/MicYou-Dev/MicYou/commit/352c7a34aea8853a00fd9a487f15a892821552f9
* 加固控制帧读取与采集循环 by @ChouChiu in https://github.com/MicYou-Dev/MicYou/commit/df2d53da7c50912dd562f79fd2e1b4c242d37fc2
* IP 为空的错误提示本地化，串行化 IP 变更后的重启 by @ChouChiu in https://github.com/MicYou-Dev/MicYou/commit/2e772cb5be8eb25bb47e8fbfda0d8f9ed24f4bf9
* 服务通知与取色器标题本地化 by @ChouChiu in https://github.com/MicYou-Dev/MicYou/commit/4c342ae66dad1d4e1030a57924bd601db0d75435
* 背景图选择改用 PickVisualMedia，修复 api21 兼容构建 by @ChouChiu in https://github.com/MicYou-Dev/MicYou/commit/07051200b6c50d38d14cbe908d9990ea8d5ceb33
* 清理废弃代码与过时 API by @ChouChiu in https://github.com/MicYou-Dev/MicYou/commit/c6db71510b6217ac8f076c3749dd353efb2fc055

### 依赖与维护

* 精简并升级依赖 by @ChouChiu in https://github.com/MicYou-Dev/MicYou/pull/356
* 迁移到 Tailwind CSS 4，升级 animejs 4、vue-i18n 11、@vueuse/core 15 by @ChouChiu in https://github.com/MicYou-Dev/MicYou/commit/316cfae0bb4afd36aad86a9e897dd7fe125da579
* 升级 cpal 0.18、rubato 5、ringbuf 0.5、wasapi 0.25、Haze 2 by @ChouChiu in https://github.com/MicYou-Dev/MicYou/commit/bb2d522f08410bac1c4c842cb083ae652eb82754
* 仓库迁移到 MicYou-Dev 组织 by @LanRhyme in https://github.com/MicYou-Dev/MicYou/commit/38f54541b9fd70b9e6b860df355a35edb70a9f6b
* 清理代码 by @chen1plus in https://github.com/MicYou-Dev/MicYou/pull/337

## New Contributors
* @chen1plus made their first contribution in https://github.com/MicYou-Dev/MicYou/pull/336

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/MicYou-Dev/MicYou/compare/v2.0.3...v2.1.0
